comparison.objective: Install safety caps on exposed rebar stubs.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick up bulky caps, coaxially align blind bores over bars, and push them down far enough to engage gripping fins.
comparison.success_condition: All five bars have fully seated, retained caps and both robot tools remain clear for three seconds; dislodged caps revoke credit.
comparison.reason: This is repeated axial press-fit insertion and retention, not rotational adjustment with coupled screw-and-nut countertorque or functional cycling.
